title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 6 — Congratulations Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: Your colleague and close friend has just been promoted to a senior management position at your company. You were not able to congratulate them in person because you are currently working abroad on a six-week project.
questions.prompt:
Your colleague and close friend has just been promoted to a senior management position at your company. You were not able to congratulate them in person because you are currently working abroad on a six-week project.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• congratulate your friend on their promotion
• explain why you were unable to congratulate them in person
• suggest meeting up to celebrate when you return

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Some people think that success in the workplace depends mostly on natural talent, while others believe hard work and dedication are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
